player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id}. Wo reko Memory Game.
Wo botae ne sɛ wo bɛma pairs of cards pii wɔ board no so sen wo opponent.
Wɔ wo turn mu, wo bɛhwehwɛ cards mmienu a wo bɛ flip denam row ne column numbers a edi kan ne nea ɛto so mmienu te sɛ '[0 1 1 0]', baako a edi kan no wɔ row 0 ne column 1, na nea ɛto so mmienu no wɔ row 1 ne column 0.
Sɛ cards mmienu no match, wo bɛnya point mmienu na cards no bɛtena wɔ anim. Sɛ wɔnnyɛ match, cards no bɛdan wɔ ase, e.g. '.'.
Game no bɛba awie bere a pairs nyinaa aba matched.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nkrataa a enni mu. Ɔbɔadeɛ {player_id} antumi ammɔ ɔbra pa wɔ ntweaseɛ no so.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Akwan a enni mu. Agorɔfoɔ {player_id} apaw baabi wɔ mmirika akyi no ho kwan.
invalid_move.same_card_twice: Akwan a enni mu. Agorɔfoɔ {player_id} paw krataa koro no ara mprenu.
invalid_move.already_matched: Nkɔsoɔ a enni mu. Agoroma {player_id} paw krataa baako anaa mmienu no nyinaa a wɔadi kan aka abom dedaw.

game_message.cards_match: Koko a Player {player_id} ahyɛ wɔ positions [{r1} {c1}] ne [{r2} {c2}] no match!
game_message.cards_no_match: Koko a Player {player_id} ahyɛ no nnyɛ match. Koko wɔ positions [{r1} {c1}] ne [{r2} {c2}] yɛ {pos1} ne {pos2} sɛnea ɛteɛ.

outcome.draw: Ná agumadifo no nyinaa kura nkrataa abien a edi nsɛ.
outcome.turn_limit: Ɛberɛ a wɔbɔ no aba. Agorɔ no awie. Player 0 nyaa {score_0} akonta, Player 1 nyaa {score_1} akonta.
